trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: I wish I used more butter in the cake.
trap.right: I wish I had used more butter in the cake.
trap.why: Para arrependimento do passado, o português usa “quem me dera tivesse usado”. O brasileiro traduz com passado simples; use wish + had + particípio.

mcq.q: I wish I **___** so much sugar.

fix.wrong: I wish I didn’t eat that.
fix.right: I wish I hadn’t eaten that.

fix.wrong: She wishes she had went home.
fix.right: She wishes she had gone home.

fix.wrong: I wish I would have called.

rewrite.answer: I wish I had used butter.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I ate too much.” (I wish… not)
rewrite.answer: I wish I hadn’t eaten so much.
She wishes she had gone home.
